reviews.title: Nice
reviews.comment: This portable plug-in DVD player for laptops works great! Setup was quick and simple, and it reads discs smoothly without lag. Lightweight, compact, and perfect for laptops without drives. Reliable and very convenient.
reviews.author: MrMrsG

reviews.title: Works well and good value
reviews.comment: Works surprisingly well. My computer doesn't have a DVD drive and I wanted to rip my CD's onto thumb drives and it worked just fine. I didn't need to power supply. The USB port provided enough power. Good value.
reviews.author: Paul D

reviews.title: Works.
reviews.comment:
Pro:  It works.
Cons:
- Built in cable only several inches long; made awkward to work with.
- Requires external power, provided cable that plugs into USB-A port, laptop power was not enough; used phone charger I had.
reviews.author: Kapitain

reviews.title: Fast and easy
reviews.comment: Fast and easy set up. Does not burn cds or dvds but plays them well. Great for keeping the kids busy when powers out
reviews.author: Wendy
